entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What...? Excuse me, but could you[n]please repeat that?

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Now, nothing's been decided as of yet...

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: But at the rate that things are going,[n]Yoshizawa-san's honor status could[n]possibly be revoked.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Something so serious should, of course,[n]be brought to the attention of both[n]her parents and yourself.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've been told that her results at the[n]latest meet were quite laudable...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Isn't revoking her status as an honor[n]student a bit of an overreaction on[n]the school's part?

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: I understand how you feel, but...[n]Well, third place doesn't really[n]cut it in this case...

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: She needs to attain first-place results[n]for her exceptional status to be[n]worthwhile.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Don't get me wrong here. Personally,[n]I think her results are impressive, but...

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: I suppose the argument could be made[n]that if she's going to represent Shujin and[n]receive special treatment, it's not enough.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Please don't shoot the messenger here,[n]okay? This is necessary to guarantee[n]fairness across the entire student body.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: It's not as if you've been expelled or the[n]like. Another meet's coming soon—please[n]try for the results the school wants to see.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Sir, putting excessive expectations on[n]Yoshizawa-san will only be to her[n]detriment.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Oh, that wasn't at all my intention![n]I just wanted to give her a little[n]encouragement.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Dr. Maruki, please continue serving[n]the student body as counselor and[n]providing support to Yoshizawa-san.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: This meeting was merely meant to[n]express how the entire faculty will[n]be supporting her.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: That's the reason I had you sit in today,[n]Dr. Maruki.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Supporting her... I see.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: At any rate, that's all I wanted to[n]discuss with you today.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Please keep in mind, these changes are[n]all hypothetical—unless Yoshizawa-san[n]doesn't provide better results.

entries.speaker: Middle-Aged Teacher
entries.en: Well, I suppose we should wrap up here.
